idea-plugin.name: DevSnip Pro: API Client & Backend Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
A REST and GraphQL API client inside the IDE, ported from the DevSnip Pro VS Code extension.

  • Send HTTP requests with params, headers and JSON, text, form or GraphQL bodies
  • Bearer, Basic, API key (header or query) and OAuth 2.0 token authentication
  • Environments with {{variables}}; secret variables are kept in the IDE password safe
  • Status, timing, size, headers and formatted JSON responses, with clear error diagnosis
  • Retries with backoff, redirect limits, timeouts, proxy and SSL options, cookies
  • cURL import and export, request history with JSON and CSV export

Plus the rest of the Backend & API toolkit:

  • cURL Converter: cURL to fetch, Axios, Node, Python, Go, PHP, Java, Dart, Kotlin/OkHttp, Swift, raw HTTP and HTTPie
  • API Response Inspector: status meaning, pagination, rate limits, caching hints and a field list
  • URL & Query String Tool: parse, build and encode URLs; query strings to and from nested JSON
  • CORS Builder & Debugger: config for Express, NestJS, Next.js, Fastify, nginx and FastAPI; browser-accurate checks
  • OpenAPI / Swagger Toolkit: lint, TypeScript types, a typed fetch client, cURL examples, spec from samples
  • GraphQL Formatter & Types: format, minify, request bodies, SDL to TypeScript
  • API Resource Scaffolder: CRUD APIs for Express, NestJS, Next.js, Fastify, Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core and FastAPI

Open it from View | Tool Windows | DevSnip Pro or Tools | DevSnip Pro: Backend & API.
